annotations.text: You tell us where you are today — income, expenses, debt, savings — and where you want to go: travel, car, home, study, business.
The AI determines what's achievable. Honest distances per goal, each with its lever — never a verdict.
It prioritises competing goals and shows how much to allocate — where the $260 goes, and when.
The best path forward. Today at the bottom, the life you want at the top. Allocation and status on every milestone.
The trade-offs you may need to make — shown as real options with real dates, and what each does to the other goals.
Following the path: one question per payday. Partly counts. Not a budgeting app — a layer over the roadmap.
As your life changes, the roadmap automatically adapts — before and after, and a choice about what to protect.
As you achieve goals, resources redirect toward what's next. The one loud moment.
